title: Catalog release snapshot assets: model tiles, cost badges, and deprecation states
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Create a coherent set of onboarding and release visuals for the Model Catalog + Pricing section to be used in release notes, quickstarts, and product docs. Deliverables include updated model tiles, per-model cost badges (token-based and flat-rate), deprecation/retired tile states, 2x density PNG exports, and a Figma file with component variants for light/dark mode. Visuals should work as hero screenshots for the release note and as inline images for the Quickstart guide.
acceptance_criteria: Figma file with component library and named variants published to the Redwood team file (components: model-tile, cost-badge, deprecation-overlay, pricing-table-row)
High-res PNG exports at 1440px and 800px for hero and inline docs, plus 2x retina assets (PNG@2x)
SVG cost-badge with accessible color contrast and tooltip copy in a separate text file
Three tile states: Active (new), Stable (default), Deprecated (warning overlay) — each with left-aligned model name, right-aligned cost badge, and small capability tags
Alt text and short captions for each asset provided in the Drive folder and in the export manifest
Design sign-off from PM (Daniel Cho) and Engineering lead (Priya Nair) before handoff to marketing/docs
assets_requested: Export manifest (CSV) listing filenames, alt text, captions, and recommended usage
README with redlines and spacing system for engineers
